name: Crate of Inn Supplies
summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Crate of Inn Supplies waits for a journey to Kharanos. Troggs have cut off the mountain pass, so the Thunderbrew Distillery depends on travelers to carry its goods.

sections.title: Through the Trogg Pass
sections.body: The Crate of Inn Supplies is waiting near Anvilmar for a safe way through Coldridge Pass. Troggs have cut off the route, stopping civilian couriers until Mountaineers can clear the road. Hands Springsprocket packed the crate with tavern provisions for Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos, where the supplies are needed.

faq.answer: The crate holds general tavern supplies sent from Coldridge Valley to keep the inn in Kharanos stocked for travelers and locals seeking warmth.

faq.q: Who sends the crate to Kharanos?
faq.answer: Hands Springsprocket packages the crate near Anvilmar and asks travelers leaving Coldridge Valley to carry it through the mountain pass.

faq.q: Why couldn't the normal courier deliver it?
faq.answer: Troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, making it too dangerous for ordinary couriers without Mountaineer escorts. Travelers able to fight through are the inn's immediate hope of receiving the supplies.
Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, receives the parcel.

angles.text: As a young dwarf, carrying these supplies is your first service beyond Coldridge Valley. You brave the trogg-choked pass to help your kin in Kharanos.
As a newly arrived gnome, carrying Hands Springsprocket's package is a practical way to earn goodwill among the local dwarves who run Dun Morogh's inns.
